entries.en: We don't want no trouble there, all right?
entries.ro: Nu vrem belele pe acolo, bine?

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="pendejo" b="No way I'm shakin' that " a="'s hand."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="pendejo" b="Nici mort nu-i dau mâna " a="pendejoului."/>

entries.en: Then it's best you don't come at all.
entries.ro: Atunci mai bine nu vii deloc.
